name: Spaceward Ho!
description: Spaceward Ho! was a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry utilized by the Galactic Republic's military against the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone War. It was distinguishable by the nose art of a green-skinned female Twi'lek pin-up model, posing in a seductive manner, present on both sides of the gunship's bow—as well as marked tallies that indicated an amassed total of fourteen vulture droid starfighters, destroyed, accompanied by the total number of, approximately, thirty-three bombs dropped on targets.
